name: lob_slope_bid
formula: cov([1..5] bidsz_1..5)/var([1..5]) numpy linear regression slope

name: microprice_L3_corr
formula: microprice_L1 + a2*(imb2-imb1) + a3*(imb3-imb2) where a_k from training

name: ofi_pca1_W5
formula: dot(OFI_L1..5_W5 pc1_weights) where pc1 frozen from training

name: ofi_pca2_W5
formula: dot(OFI_L1..5_W5 pc2_weights) where pc2 frozen from training

name: iofi_pca_W5
formula: dot(all 5 syms ofi_pca1_W5 vector pc_cross) first cross-sym PC

name: rv_5tick
formula: sum((logret_k)^2 for k in last 5 ticks)

name: delta_cross_logret_W5_W20
formula: logret_W5[i] - logret_W20[j] for frozen best lead-lag pair j

name: delta_lag_ofi_W5_W20
formula: OFI_W5[i] - OFI_W20[j] for frozen best lead-lag pair j

name: pair_spread_convergence_rate
source: Price Spread DL Pairs 2024 Int Rev Fin

name: lagged_cross_iofi_W5
formula: ofi_pca1_W5[j] for fixed best lagged-impact pair j (frozen from training)

name: triple_ofi_product_sign
formula: sign(OFI_W5[i])*sign(OFI_W5[j])*sign(OFI_W5[k]) for best frozen triplet j k

name: hyperedge_ofi_mean_W5
formula: mean(OFI_W5[i j k]) - OFI_W5[i] for frozen best triplet j k

name: causal_ofi_pair_W5
formula: OFI_W5[i]-OFI_W5[j] when sign(logret_W5[j])==sign(OFI_W5[i]) else 0 for best pair j
